title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am working in a company & this company has some equipments in spare which will never be used & can be scrapped. My Manager has asked me to get them scrap & he doesn't expect any money out of it. Wheras i know that these equipments can be sold in the market & can get some money out of it. Please advise, if i make an arrangement with a company to collect all these equipments from my company & send it to my home or sell it in the market & then pay me that money & i can use that money for my day to day purpose. Will this money be considered as "Halal" 2619 views Q. I like to confirm I am in student visa in UK. I am a university lecturer. I have applied to my university for study leave with pay. The university requires a bond that the person availing study leave will serve for the duration equal to the duration of study leave otherwise he/she will pay two times(double) of the salary that he will get during the period of study leave. This "two times condition" looks me as if involving Riba(sood). Please clear whether this is Riba. Can I sign this bond agreement with the university? If not then guide me what to do. Please reply me as early as possible because in three days I am to sign this bond. 1694 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36270 Country: India Title: One of my cousins has paid bribe to join a school as a teacher, in the name of donation, if he would not have paid the bribe, someone else would have been appointed for that position Question: One of my cousins has paid bribe to join a school as a teacher, in the name of donation, if he would not have paid the bribe, someone else would have been appointed for that position. I want to ask that, is his income now halal or haram. All the people in the school Trust are Muslim and school is Urdu medium. Please suggest. Answer ID: 36270 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 189/L=106/TL=1433) If he is doing his assigned jobs properly then his income shall not be termed as haram. His income shall be halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
